sentences.text: This course is for anyone who writes skills, or builds an agent into an app, and wants evidence in place of a hunch.

sentences.text: We take one short skill, which writes changelog entries, and measure it with Vally.

sentences.text: First we measure the skill, and read what the agent really did.

sentences.text: Then we build graders we can trust, and ask whether the skill earns its place.

sentences.text: We add a judge for what code can't check, and learn what a result does and doesn't support.
